title: One-off script: backfill refund reasons from the support export
body: Support exported ~11k legacy tickets with refund reasons. This script fills `refunds.reason` where it is NULL. Run once from a bastion against a snapshot first, then prod. Will delete the script after it has run.
author: carol

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+"""One-off: backfill refunds.reason from the legacy support-ticket export (June 2026)."""
+
+import csv
+import os
+import sys
+
+from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
+
+engine = create_engine(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"])
+
+with open(sys.argv[1]) as f, engine.begin() as conn:
+    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
+        conn.execute(
+            text("UPDATE refunds SET reason = :reason WHERE id = :id AND reason IS NULL"),
+            {"reason": row["reason"], "id": row["refund_id"]},
+        )
+        print("updated", row["refund_id"])
